subject.declared_domain: NFRA_GLOBGRPH P2-STITCH step-2: unions the portal/pipeline subgraph (step-1 extract_portal_stitch) with the comp-aws AWS-resource layer (the nightly snapshot) and DERIVES the inter-system STITCH edges that join them, resolving portal name/path identities to AWS ARNs so both layers meet on one ARN-keyed node. Writes stitch_graph.json -- view 2's source in NFRA_C3MATERIALIZE.

as_of.graph_vintage: Reads the AWS layer at RUN time from s3://opal-313476888478-globgrph/snapshots/latest.txt, which resolved this session to snapshots/20260830/graph-20260830.tar.gz (LastModified 2026-08-30T02:11:49Z, 1,638,952 B). The subject FILE itself last changed at 393a8b723e (2026-07-07); the vintage that governs its OUTPUT is the snapshot pointer, not the file.

methodology.how: load_aws_layer() pulls the pointer snapshots/latest.txt, fetches the named tarball and json-loads member[0] into the AWS graph dict. _index_aws() builds name->arn indices for LAMBDA and S3_BUCKET plus the AWS node-key set. build_stitched_graph() then unions three node/edge sources (AWS snapshot, extract_portal_stitch, trace_graph.build_graph) and walks the comp-trace edges emitting five inter-layer edge types: ROUTES_TO, WRITES, READS, DERIVES_FROM, STORED_IN. Edges are deduped on (source,target,edge_type); a wildcard- and transient-exempt 0-dangling check runs; run_grain_sentinel() gates emission and main() REFUSES to write on a grain violation (rc=2).

stages_inferential: LAMBDA identity resolution (lam(), derive_stitch.py:113-129): on a name miss it RETRIES with name.replace('_','-') and then 'opal-'+hyphenated to bridge documented code-vs-live naming drift. A normalized candidate matching a DIFFERENT real Lambda is recorded in stats['lam_matched'] and is indistinguishable from a true match. No LLM is involved -- the inference is heuristic string normalization.
STORED_IN placement (:161-169): a firm-relative key does not carry its firm, so the loop emits one edge to EVERY present firm bucket -- a possibility asserted in the grammar of a fact.
stages_deterministic: the three-way node/edge union and the (source,target,edge_type) dedup (:88-105, :171-173)
the grain sentinel gate and refuse-to-emit on violation (:243-248)

composes: the comp-aws nightly AWS-resource snapshot (S3 tarball, ARN-keyed)
org.modules.graph.trace_graph.build_graph(ws) -- the repo trace graph, the source of the cross-layer relationships
invents: STORED_IN edges as a FAN-OUT: one edge per present firm bucket per firm-relative key, so the edge asserts a POSSIBILITY and reads as a FACT. With 5 buckets in FIRM_DATA_BUCKETS, at most one such edge per key can be true, and a consumer reading STORED_IN as 'this key lives in this bucket' is wrong for the rest.
LAMBDA matches recovered by name normalization ('_'->'-', 'opal-' prefix), counted as matched with no marker separating a normalized match from an exact one

coverage.universe: Every node and edge in the union of three graphs, plus the five derived inter-layer edge types. Node universe = AWS snapshot nodes (ARN-keyed) UNION portal/pipeline nodes (path/name-keyed). Edge universe = AWS edges + portal edges + derived STITCH edges, deduped on (source,target,edge_type).
coverage.denominator: The producer PRINTS its own denominators every run and carries them in meta.stitch_stats: total_nodes, total_edges, genuine_dangling, and per-type routes_to / writes / reads / derives_from / stored_in, plus lam_matched and lam_unmatched. It does NOT carry the denominator that would size its own inference: stored_in is a COUNT OF EMITTED EDGES, not a count of keys, so the fan-out multiplies it by the number of present firm buckets and no field records that multiplier. A reader taking stored_in as 'number of keys placed' overcounts by up to 5x.
explicitly_out: Lambdas whose trace name resolves to no AWS name even after normalization -- carried as _unmatched_lambdas and counted in lam_unmatched, i.e. DISCLOSED rather than silently dropped

Dangling edges whose endpoint is a wildcard/pseudo-principal (_wild: non-arn ids starting with *, event-source::, external-endpoint::, service-principal::, external-principal::, wildcard:, or containing * or ::) -- exempted from the 0-dangling check by design
ECS cluster/task endpoints (_known_transient: ':ecs:' in the id) -- exempted pending a WAVE-4-inclusive nightly derive, per CTO ruling 184757Z
S3 keys NOT under platinum/|gold/|silver/|bronze/ -- they receive no STORED_IN edge at all

firm buckets absent from the snapshot -- present_firm_buckets intersects FIRM_DATA_BUCKETS with what the snapshot actually carries, so a missing bucket silently reduces the fan-out rather than erroring
_genuine_dangling is TRUNCATED TO 20 in the returned dict while meta.genuine_dangling carries the true count -- the sample and the count are different quantities and only the count is complete

key.identity_space: MULTI-SPACE BY CONSTRUCTION, and reconciling the spaces is this script's entire purpose. AWS nodes are ARN-keyed; portal/pipeline nodes are path/name-keyed ('lambda:NAME', 's3:<key>'); trace nodes carry their own ids. The join is performed by lam() (trace lambda name -> ARN) and by the STORED_IN boundary edge (firm-relative key -> bucket ARN). _index_aws keys on (arn or id), so a node lacking an arn silently falls back to its id and enters the same key set as an ARN.
key.declared_mapping: Declared in the module docstring at derive_stitch.py:11-21 (the five STITCH edge types and the name->ARN intent) and implemented at :113-129 (lam) and :161-169 (STORED_IN). The docstring declares WHAT joins; it does not declare that the name->ARN step may match a normalized candidate, nor that STORED_IN is one-to-many.
key.evidence: _index_aws at derive_stitch.py:72-86 (node_keys.add(arn or nid); lam_by_name[n.get('name') or nid]); lam normalization at :113-129; STORED_IN at :161-169. Rated UNSTABLE, not stable, on two grounds read at source: the same logical Lambda is addressable under at least three spellings (trace basename, hyphenated, opal-prefixed) with no canonical form recorded on the emitted edge; and an AWS node without an arn is keyed by id, so one entity can occupy two key shapes within one run.

failure_mode.returns_on_failure: MIXED, and the mixture is the finding. LOUD paths: load_aws_layer() has no exception handling, so a missing pointer, absent tarball or malformed member RAISES and the run dies; a grain-sentinel violation prints GRAIN_SENTINEL_FAIL and RETURNS 2 WITHOUT WRITING (the refuse-to-emit gate, derive_stitch.py:243-248); genuine dangling edges return rc=1 while still writing. SILENT path: _load_grain_baseline() at :255-260 wraps its read in a bare 'except Exception: return {}', so an unreadable, missing or malformed baseline yields {} -- and the function's own docstring states that omitting the baseline degrades the sentinel to 'AC-GRAIN.1 only'. The instrument therefore drops from two checks to one, prints its normal PASS render, and exits 0.
silent_degrade_paths: _load_grain_baseline() bare except at :259 -> {} -> grain sentinel runs AC-GRAIN.1 only -> a magnitude/count regression that AC-GRAIN.2 exists to catch passes unnoticed, with rc=0 and no warning line
lam() normalization matching a DIFFERENT real Lambda -> counted in lam_matched -> a wrong ARN is stitched and reads as a successful join
a firm bucket missing from the snapshot -> present_firm_buckets shrinks -> fewer STORED_IN edges emitted, stored_in count drops, and nothing distinguishes that from there being fewer keys
failure_mode.evidence: EXERCISED, not read. Imported the module and called _load_grain_baseline() twice with arms reaching DIFFERENT truths: ARM1 with the real org/modules/graph/grain_baseline.json (present, 12,266 B) -> dict with 35 keys; ARM2 with GRAIN_BASELINE repointed to a nonexistent path -> dict with 0 keys. Discriminator: ARM2 == {} is True, i.e. byte-identical to a genuinely empty baseline; ARM1 != ARM2 confirms the arms are not degenerate. Source at derive_stitch.py:255-260; the 'omit -> AC-GRAIN.1 only' claim is the function's own docstring at :256.

verdict.why: The design is careful and unusually self-instrumented for this estate: it refuses to emit a grain-violating graph rather than warning, it discloses its own unmatched-Lambda set instead of dropping it, it exempts wildcard and transient endpoints deliberately with a cited ruling, and it carries its denominators in meta on every run. The artifact is current (02:38:14Z at carding) and the artifact-first/marker-last ordering was confirmed live. QUALIFIED rather than SOUND on three measured defects, none of which requires redesign: (1) the DECLARED cadence is not the operating one -- the nightly EventBridge->CodeBuild leg is ENABLED and has failed 20 of its 20 most recent fires, 2026-08-10 through 2026-08-29, with zero successes, while a different unidentified path keeps the artifact fresh and thereby hides the outage; (2) the grain baseline loads through a bare except, so an unreadable baseline is byte-identical to an empty one and silently halves the sentinel while the run still exits 0 -- EXERCISED this session, both arms; (3) STORED_IN is a one-to-many fan-out emitted as a plain edge, so it asserts a possibility in the grammar of a fact and its stored_in counter counts EDGES while reading as keys. QUALIFIED is a statement about load-bearing standing TODAY: the output is fresh and usable now, and the mechanism that is supposed to guarantee that has not worked in twenty days.
